pipeline_failure_detail: Machine wrapper returned 0 and published the result, but numeric decoding of six Task-4.1 arrays failed because numcodecs was missing in the canonical research venv. This is a decoding/dependency prerequisite failure, not a scientific negative.

source_provenance.dataset: TokaMark v1 MAST Zarr-v2 derived from FAIR-MAST
source_provenance.license: TokaMark CC BY 4.0; FAIR-MAST CC BY-SA 4.0 except where noted
source_provenance.timing_calibration: No numeric time coordinate decoded; time alignment and event lead times unverified.

successful_milestone: Seven bounded canonical MAST shot-21719 Zarr objects were fetched and content-hashed (512,664 bytes), demonstrating bounded remote chunk retrieval without bulk download. The missing numcodecs prerequisite was diagnosed explicitly.
interpretation: The bounded fetch succeeded but numerical decoding failed on six arrays due to missing numcodecs. No calibrated time/signal pairs, event statistics, reachability, or TCT efficacy were established. Existing successor 103 already repaired numcodecs and reran the bounded decode; its result found one valid PF coil-current pair but magnetic and D-alpha first-chunk length mismatches, so further precursor interpretation remains blocked. Do not queue a duplicate successor.
observational_status: bounded_chunk_access_only; no event analysis, no prospective shot-level statistics, no causal analog or controller-in-loop test
m3dc1_claim_boundary: M3D-C1-only gates and zero/handoff equivalence remain frozen and unmapped to imported MAST shot data. No normalized-native-M3D-C1 validation inferred.
pb11_fidelity_limits: not_applicable; no p-B11 reaction, alpha transport, channeling, direct conversion, rotation, liquid-lithium or net-power inference
